b1-sociedadcolonial-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Creating the Viceroyalties
b1-sociedadcolonial-01.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are watching a documentary about the Spanish empire, and he asks which viceroyalty was created first.
b1-sociedadcolonial-01.prompt: Tell Carlos what was created in 1535.
cues: Say that a viceroyalty was created, using se
Give the year and the name, New Spain
b1-sociedadcolonial-01.target: En 1535 se creó el virreinato de Nueva España.
b1-sociedadcolonial-01.english: In 1535 the viceroyalty of New Spain was created.
b1-sociedadcolonial-01.canDo: I can use the passive with *se* to say what was created and decided in the empire.

b1-sociedadcolonial-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Group You Belonged To
b1-sociedadcolonial-02.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are at a museum exhibition about colonial society, and she asks why a person's origin mattered so much.
b1-sociedadcolonial-02.prompt: Tell Meg what the group a person belonged to affected.
cues: Say that a person belonged to a group, with a relative clause
Say what the group affected, for example their rights
b1-sociedadcolonial-02.target: El grupo al que pertenecía una persona influía en sus derechos.
b1-sociedadcolonial-02.english: The group a person belonged to affected their rights.
b1-sociedadcolonial-02.canDo: I can use *el que*, *la que*, *los que* and *las que* after a preposition to describe colonial groups.

b1-sociedadcolonial-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Why the Friars Learned Languages
b1-sociedadcolonial-03.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are reading a book about the Church in the colony, and he asks why the friars learned indigenous languages.
b1-sociedadcolonial-03.prompt: Tell Carlos why the friars learned indigenous languages.
cues: Say that the friars learn languages
Say the purpose with para que, about the indigenous people
b1-sociedadcolonial-03.target: Los frailes aprenden lenguas indígenas para que los indígenas entiendan el mensaje.
b1-sociedadcolonial-03.english: The friars learn indigenous languages so that the indigenous people understand the message.
b1-sociedadcolonial-03.canDo: I can use *para que* + subjunctive to say why one person did something for another.

b1-sociedadcolonial-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A Day in the Plaza
b1-sociedadcolonial-04.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are on a trip planned to an old colonial city, and she asks what people did in the plaza long ago.
b1-sociedadcolonial-04.prompt: Tell Meg what the residents usually did in the plaza.
cues: Say how often, with a frequency adverb
Say that the residents went to the plaza to buy food
b1-sociedadcolonial-04.target: Normalmente, los vecinos iban a la plaza para comprar comida.
b1-sociedadcolonial-04.english: Normally, the residents went to the plaza to buy food.
b1-sociedadcolonial-04.canDo: I can use *normalmente*, *a menudo*, *de vez en cuando* and *cada día* to say how often things happened.

b1-sociedadcolonial-05.title: Communicative Challenge: What Mestizaje Became
b1-sociedadcolonial-05.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are talking about a class on the colony, and he asks what mestizaje meant for colonial life.
b1-sociedadcolonial-05.prompt: Tell Carlos what mestizaje became in colonial life.
cues: Say that it was a very important fact of colonial life
b1-sociedadcolonial-05.target: El mestizaje se convirtió en un hecho muy importante de la vida colonial.
b1-sociedadcolonial-05.english: Mestizaje became a very important fact of colonial life.
b1-sociedadcolonial-05.canDo: I can use *convertirse en*, *hacerse*, *quedarse* and *pasar de ser … a ser …* to say how people and groups changed.

b1-sociedadcolonial-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Summing Up Colonial Society
b1-sociedadcolonial-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are preparing for a class on the colony, and she asks you to sum up how the empire was organised.
b1-sociedadcolonial-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg what was created in 1542.
cues: Say that a viceroyalty was created, using se
Name the viceroyalty and the year
b1-sociedadcolonial-consolidation.target: En 1542 se creó el virreinato del Perú.
b1-sociedadcolonial-consolidation.english: In 1542 the viceroyalty of Peru was created.
b1-sociedadcolonial-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about colonial society with the passive with *se*, relative clauses with a preposition, *para que*, frequency adverbs and verbs of change.
